vo: Welcome to The Training Notebook One.
Thanks for your patience while we moved your account.
Tap a client to open them.
Profile has their details, notes and intake form.
Tap the three dots, then workout notes.
Your notes from the original app are here, and in each exercise's notes.
The assess tab has their check ins and charts.
Messages is your chat with them.
Your templates are in the menu, under program templates.
Pick pounds or kilos in settings.
If you need more help, just reply to this email.
